observation: Fresh main already propagated the ChangeSet 128-file hard budget into federated selection, but a single write larger than 2,000,000 UTF-8 bytes could still remain executable and win federation even though ChangesetStore.stage deterministically rejects the same write with CHANGE_FILE_TOO_LARGE.
changes: Reuse the existing ChangeSet 2,000,000-byte per-file hard budget in federated proposal normalization.
Fail a proposal closed before ranking when any otherwise-valid write exceeds that established byte limit, and expose file_byte_overflow / oversized_file_count with risk evidence.
Preserve exactly-2,000,000-byte writes and all existing change-count, path, preimage, validation, consensus, and ranking semantics.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: normalizeChange accepted arbitrary-length string content while ChangesetStore.stage rejects after.length>MAX_FILE_BYTES with MAX_FILE_BYTES=2_000_000.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: normalized valid writes are measured with Buffer.byteLength(...,'utf8'); any file above the existing downstream hard bound makes the candidate non-executable while the exact boundary remains valid.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/federated-file-byte-budget-integrity.test.mjs proves 2,000,001 bytes fail closed, 2,000,000 bytes remain valid, and a bounded candidate wins over an oversized competitor.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted full-suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not define a new artifact-size policy. It propagates the already-existing ChangeSet single-file hard gate upstream so federation cannot select a plan guaranteed to fail staging.
